verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards will air live on ABC on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The 98th Academy Awards... on Sunday, March 15, starting at 7 p.m. EST.'; R3: 'broadcast in the US on the TV channel ABC... start at 4pm West Coast time'; R4: 'air on ABC at 7pm ET / 4pm PT on Sunday'; R5: 'air on ABC... 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT on March 15, 2026'; R6: 'air live on ABC... at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact date, time, and ABC broadcast.

verifications.claim: The 98th Academy Awards will stream on Hulu including ad-supported tiers on Sunday, March 15, 2026, at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'streamed live on the video platform Hulu'; R4: 'live stream through Hulu'; R5: 'stream live on Hulu — yes, even for a basic, ad-supported subscription... 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT on March 15, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly support Hulu streaming at the specified time, with R5 explicitly including ad-supported tiers.

verifications.claim: Red carpet coverage for the 98th Academy Awards begins at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT on ABC, Hulu, and E!.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Red carpet coverage starts at 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT on ABC and Hulu'; R1: 'ABC... at 6:30 p.m. EST... E! beginning at 4 p.m. EST'; R3: 'official red carpet... 3:30pm (22:30 GMT)' [~3:30 PT/6:30 ET?], 'E! Live... 21:00 GMT' [4 p.m. ET]; R6: 'preshow... 3:30 p.m. ET/12:30 p.m. PT' [ABC], 'E!... 4 p.m. ET'
verifications.reasoning: Sources support ABC/Hulu preshow at 3:30 ET/12:30 PT, but E! consistently starts at 4 p.m. ET, directly contradicting the claim's attribution of the time to E!.

verifications.claim: ABC is the TV channel for the 98th Academy Awards.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'ABC’s official red carpet'; R3: 'broadcast... on the TV channel ABC'; R4: 'air on ABC'; R5: 'air on ABC'; R6: 'air live on ABC'
verifications.reasoning: All relevant sources directly state ABC as the TV broadcaster.

verifications.claim: Accessing ABC for the 98th Academy Awards requires cable or antenna.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'live TV streaming platforms — like DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV, and Fubo'; R3: 'without traditional cable can access... Hulu + Live TV, YouTube TV... FuboTV'; R4: 'Sling TV... Fubo, YouTube TV and Hulu + Live TV'; R5: 'stream live on Hulu'; R6: 'stream... on Hulu or... Fubo'
verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict by listing cable-free streaming services (e.g., Hulu basic, live TV streamers) that provide ABC access without cable or antenna.

verifications.claim: Hulu is the primary streaming home for the 98th Academy Awards.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R3: 'streamed live on the video platform Hulu'; R4: 'live stream through Hulu'; R5: 'stream live on Hulu — yes, even for a basic, ad-supported subscription'
verifications.reasoning: Sources prominently mention Hulu for live streaming, but do not explicitly call it 'primary'; other services also listed elsewhere.
